verdict.rationale: An event-automation story is a fair question for a business-registry portal. The only relevant evidence is an 'Email notifications' feature (docs-11) and a topic-based email update signup (docs-27). These are fixed, event-driven alerts, not user-defined rules that trigger actions. Missing for 10: user-configurable rule definitions, triggers beyond email alerts (webhooks, automated filings or actions), any documentation of which events are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
